exposure: pharmacist-led elective caesarean section pre-admission clinic
outcome: patient preparedness for analgesic supply on discharge
requirement for discharge supply of paracetamol
requirement for discharge supply of ibuprofen
cohort: Patients admitted to maternity wards at an Australian tertiary obstetric public hospital, specifically those undergoing elective caesarean section.
finding: The introduction of a pharmacist-led elective caesarean section pre-admission clinic enhanced pharmacist workflow efficiency and best possible medication history (BPMH) completion, and improved patient preparedness for discharge medications.
